basis: FLAVOR001/FLAVOR002: install-artifact contract for one device flavor. Values marked 'from' are cross-checked by scripts/factory-package.py against the named source on every load; nothing here is evidence that an artifact was built, signed, installed or accepted on a phone.

device.from: os/devices/pixel10.json devices.rango and adevtool vendor-skels firmware/android-info.txt (require board=)

firmware.from: os/devices/pixel10.json shared.firmware, equal to the pinned adevtool android-info.txt

ota.producer: generate-release.sh ota_from_target_files, run by scripts/host-sign.py, which truncates the script before img_from_target_files
ota.applicability: In-place update only: a phone already running a build of this device whose recovery/update_engine trusts the same OTA certificate (metadata pre-device must equal the device). Never a first install, and never decomposed into partition images for fastboot.

factory.signature: {device}-install-{build}.zip.sig (ssh-keygen -Y sign -n "factory images", only when the key directory holds id_ed25519)
factory.producer: generate-release.sh after the OTA: img_from_target_files -> device/common/generate-factory-images-common.sh ({device}-factory-{build}.zip) -> fastboot -S 0x10000000 optimize-factory-image ({device}-install-{build}.zip)
factory.currentlyProducedBasis: No RoseOS job runs the factory stage: host-sign.py derive_release_script cuts at the one '\nimg_from_target_files' anchor (OTA only). The sole writer of that cut is the signing owner.

gscFirmware.copiedTo: the archive top directory, same basenames, byte-equal

generatorMembers.basis: Demonstrated by the pinned generator fixture scripts/tests/fixtures/factory-package/device_common-1f5ba267/generate-factory-images-common.sh with the variables generate-release.sh sets for rango|frankel (BOOTLOADER, RADIO, AVB_PKMD, DISABLE_UART, DISABLE_DPM; no BOOTLOADERFILE, RADIOFILE, SRCPREFIX or GSCFIRMWARESRC, so the RADIO/bootloader.img, RADIO/radio.img and dauntless defaults apply). Each anchor must occur in the fixture.

optimizeMembers.images: {partition}.img for each non-logical partition in fastbootImages that the update zip holds (raw, or Android sparse when larger than the limit); dynamic partitions only as super_1..N.img
optimizeMembers.copied: every other factory-zip member except image-*.zip, flash-all.sh, flash-all.bat and flash-base.sh, flat by basename
anchors: die("unexpected number of flash bootloader commands: %i", bootloader_flash_counter);
optimizeMembers.basis: Demonstrated by FlashCapturer::Run and its capture hooks in the pinned excerpt scripts/tests/fixtures/factory-package/platform_system_core-322ff512/fastboot-excerpt.json (GrapheneOS platform_system_core 322ff512 fastboot/). Each anchor must occur in the excerpt.

factory.dataWipeBasis: Install flash-all.sh and script.txt carry `erase <partition>` only from WipeTask, which the capture runs for fastboot-info.txt `if-wipe` lines of the update zip (wants_wipe is forced); that file's content is not pinned here.

intermediate.contains: image-{device}-{build}.zip, the generator members and GSC firmware
intermediate.classification: factory-intermediate: refused; generate-release.sh signs and ships only the optimized install archive

factory.fastbootImagesBasis: Primary (non-secondary) BootCritical/Normal rows of the fastboot images[] table in the excerpt; Extra rows (cache, super, userdata) are never flashed by flashall. Logical ones go into super

scriptChecks.super: flash super super_{index}.img, once per segment in order 1..N
scriptChecks.references: every `flash PARTITION FILE [other-slot]` line names a member of the archive
scriptChecks.maxDownloadSizeBasis: generate-release.sh MAX_DOWNLOAD_SIZE for rango|mustang|blazer|frankel, written by fastboot as 0x<hex>

inventory.source: the signed target-files the factory archive was generated from (never this file, never a guessed list)
inventory.images: IMAGES/{partition}.img: every A/B partition outside dynamic_partition_list that has one must appear byte-equal as {partition}.img
inventory.firmware: RADIO/bootloader.img and RADIO/radio.img must equal the factory bootloader-/radio- images (generator anchors). VENDOR/firmware/dauntless/* must appear byte-equal at the archive top level. An A/B partition without an IMAGES/ entry counts as firmware-carried only when a roseos.factory-firmware-observation.v1 bound to the bootloader/radio digests lists it
inventory.dynamic: dynamic_partition_list partitions: super_1..N.img rebuilt with simg2img and unpacked with lpunpack from the hash-pinned otatools archive (as the historical verify-factory-mustang.py did), the unpacked set and each logical image byte-equal to target-files IMAGES/{partition}.img (flattened with simg2img when sparse); _b outputs must be empty
inventory.layoutStatus: generator and optimizer pinned; historical target-files identity recorded; names-only member list and update-zip content unobserved
inventory.layoutBasis: The generator (device_common 1f5ba267) and optimize-factory-image (platform_system_core 322ff512) behaviour is pinned. No Frankel or Rango target-files, img zip or fastboot-info.txt listing is in this repository; a missing entry refuses, it never passes.
inventory.observation: roseos.target-files-observation.v2 from `factory-package.py observe`: target-files sha256 and the names of META/ IMAGES/ RADIO/ OTA/ VENDOR/firmware/ members, delivered by release through its normal receipt path
inventory.observedBasis: No `factory-package.py observe` names-only observation (roseos.target-files-observation.v2) is checked in, so classify still cannot bind a target-files to one. The historical inspection below records identity facts only, not the member list.

historicalObservations.source: original Infra authorized historical artifact inspection, turn 01a199bb-0783-76a4-ab00-c04459a231da (ZIP hashes and internal checksums verified there; no artifact reread or raw logs in this repository)
doesNotEstablish: current host, install, boot or phone safety
a names-only member list for classify (no observe output exists)
carried-partition mapping (firmware member hashes are not a roseos.factory-firmware-observation.v1)
an optimized install archive or super validation
an archive SSH signing identity (factorySigning stays null; the AVB pin is not that key)

installSemantics.abUpdateBasis: required to read ab_update=true from META/misc_info.txt; the install script checks slot-count 2, flashes the bootloader to the other slot twice and pins current-slot a before flashing super (pinned optimize-factory-image excerpt)
installSemantics.dynamicPartitions: read from misc_info dynamic_partition_list per artifact
installSemantics.virtualAb: recorded from misc_info virtual_ab per artifact; OTA_ARGS=--disable_ublk for these devices in generate-release.sh
installSemantics.rollback: Not claimed. A factory install wipes data; downgrade and anti-rollback behaviour on these devices is unmeasured.
installSemantics.relock: Bootloader relock eligibility needs avb_pkmd.bin equal to the flavor's AVB public key AND physical acceptance; the classifier checks only the first and never claims relock is safe.
installSemantics.generatorFlash: Generator flash-all.sh (pinned fixture): refuses a different `fastboot getvar product`, flashes the bootloader to the other slot twice with set-active, flashes radio, erases and flashes avb_custom_key from avb_pkmd.bin, `oem uart disable`, erases dpm_a/dpm_b, then `fastboot -w --skip-reboot update` (wipes data). Never run here.

identity.avbProvenance: File sha256 of the public avb_pkmd.bin asset, recorded by the completed authorized publication receipt of rango-2026103001 and carried by the FLAVOR002 packet. A public AVB key-metadata blob digest only: not the OTA certificate DER, not an SSH factory-signing key, and not an independently reread bootstrap journal (held artifact 12961047183 is never retrieved).
identity.firstUseBinding: a fold-rango-v1 first-use record passed with --first-use-binding must carry this same avbPublicKeySha256, else identity_conflict
identity.otaCertificateSha256From: runtime: the fold-rango-v1 first-use record (not pinned here)
identity.signingKeys: fold-rango-v1 first-use containers (signing owner; never read here)

retained.basis: Signed by host-sign.py (OTA only) under os/retained-rango/release.json; docs/VERIFY.md: manual OTA publication, first install and phone acceptance not shown. Its published notes' 'manual installation' means an in-place OTA on an already-installed matching Rango build, not a first install. Published bytes, notes and receipts are preserved unchanged.

missingForFactory.input: factory stage of generate-release.sh for the retained rango build
missingForFactory.next: same opt-in tail as frankel, run against the retained rango-target_files.zip under the existing first-use identity

missingForFactory.input: factory-signing identity (principal + ssh-ed25519 public key, namespace "factory images")
missingForFactory.next: decide whether RoseOS signs install archives; if so, provision the key in the signing route and pin its public half in factorySigning

missingForFactory.input: names-only observation of a signed rango target-files
missingForFactory.next: the 2026103001 signed target-files identity (73db76e5…0baf0, 4,927,914,252 bytes, 2,874 members) is recorded historically; its names-only `factory-package.py observe` output still has to come through release's normal receipt path

missingForFactory.input: firmware observation of bootloader/radio carried partitions
missingForFactory.next: emit roseos.factory-firmware-observation.v1 from the generator's own inputs alongside the install archive; the historical bootloader/radio/firmware member hashes are not this mapping

missingForFactory.input: physical first-install acceptance on a Pixel 10 Pro Fold
missingForFactory.owner: QA with an explicit device handback
missingForFactory.next: only after a classifier-ready archive exists

factorySigning.owner: signing (Chief approval for any new identity)
factorySigning.basis: generate-release.sh signs {device}-install-{build}.zip with ssh-keygen -Y sign -n "factory images" -f $KEY_DIR/id_ed25519 only when that key exists; os/signing-bootstrap/profiles.json: id_ed25519 is optional and not produced by generate-keys. The pin is bound from the fold-rango-factory-v1 bootstrap public receipt (os/retained-rango/factory-signing-bootstrap-receipt.json, run 41705002875 attempt 1); scripts/factory-archive-sign.py check cross-checks it. Never generated here and never derived from OTA/AVB keys.
factorySigning.verifier: ssh-keygen -Y verify -f <allowed_signers from this pin only> -I principal -n "factory images" -s ARCHIVE.sig
